moods.title: Misty
moods.summary: Soft light and forms fading into mist.

sceneries.title: Railway
sceneries.summary: Rail tracks, bridges and tunnels through the landscape.
sceneries.story: Railways trace narrow corridors through the land, often using bridges and tunnels to maintain a gentle grade.

photos.title: Mianyue’s Cliffside Gallery
photos.blurb: Rail tracks pass beneath a weathered stone arch, with a row of concrete openings following the mist-covered mountainside.
photos.story: This open-sided shelter was built to protect trains from falling rock, but landslides eventually broke through it. The 1999 earthquake and Typhoon Morakot in 2009 severely damaged the Mianyue Line.

trails.title: Mianyue Line
trails.summary: A former logging railway through the cloud-covered mountains of Alishan, Taiwan, with cliffside tunnels and forest bridges.
trails.story: Built in 1915 to carry timber, the 9.2-kilometer railway became a passenger sightseeing line in 1983.
